question: A small electronic chip is used in a circuit instead of connecting many separate transistors, diodes and resistors. What is this chip called, and why is it preferred in modern electronic devices?

options.A: It is a semiconductor diode, preferred because it has a large size and many external connections.
options.B: It is a transistor, preferred because it uses high power and contains only one component.
options.C: It is an integrated circuit or IC. Many components are fabricated on one chip, making devices compact, fast, low-power and reliable.
options.D: It is a resistor network, preferred because separate components always provide greater reliability.
